entries.title: Clear Attribute Values on Selected Blocks
entries.summary: Clears the text value of every attribute attached to user-selected attributed block references.
when_to_use: Selected blocks contain stale or unwanted attribute values that should be blanked before downstream processing.
inputs: User selection of attributed block references
effects: Sets each selected attribute TextString to an empty string
implementation_notes: Current implementation clears attribute values; it does not implement duplicate-tag repair despite broader wording in the header.

entries.title: Remove SOLID/TRACE/3DFACE, Solid Hatches and Wipeouts
entries.summary: Scans every block definition/space and deletes AcDbSolid, AcDbTrace, AcDb3dFace, SOLID-pattern hatches and wipeouts, then regenerates the drawing.
when_to_use: Preparing imported/Xref source drawings where those object types are intentionally disposable.
implementation_notes: The current source does not perform DGN linetype/regapp cleanup even though the legacy header mentions it. Registry description follows implementation, not filename/header intent.

entries.title: Strip MText Formatting Overrides
entries.summary: Removes embedded MText formatting control sequences from selected MTEXT objects and rewrites them as plain content that follows the text style defaults.
when_to_use: Imported MText carries local font/color/spacing formatting that should be normalized.
effects: Rewrites MTEXT DXF text chunks after stripping formatting control sequences
implementation_notes: Formatting is removed by string parsing and DXF rewrite; verify text content after use on complex stacked/escaped MText.

entries.title: Purge Reconciled Layer Metadata and Disable Notifications
entries.summary: Removes reconciled-layer extension dictionary data across layers and sets LAYEREVAL/LAYERNOTIFY to 0.
when_to_use: Layer reconciliation metadata/notifications from Xrefs need to be cleared intentionally.
implementation_notes: The file invokes c:PURGERECONCILEDLAYERS at top level, so verified load itself mutates the current drawing. Do not load merely for inspection/testing on a project drawing.

entries.title: Move Xref References to Standard XREF Layer
entries.summary: Creates/configures layer XREF (ACI 254, locked), finds Xref block references, temporarily unlocks their current host layer when required, moves each Xref reference to XREF, then restores the original layer lock state.
when_to_use: Standardizing host-drawing Xref references onto one locked coordination layer.
effects: Moves Xref references to XREF layer
Temporarily changes and restores source-layer lock state

entries.title: Map Imported/Xref Layers to Standard Coordination Layers
entries.summary: Creates a standard coordination layer set, derives source-to-target mappings from keyword rules, remaps drawing objects and nested block content, handles locked layers, prompts when mapped targets are off/frozen, and removes obsolete source layers after mapping.
when_to_use: Normalizing consultant/imported/Xref layer systems into the project's standard coordination layers.
A project-specific mapping variant is needed without permanently editing the library source.
inputs: Runtime/project mapping rules when AI adaptation is used
User choice if mapped target layers are off or frozen
effects: Creates missing standard target layers with configured ACI/linetype
Remaps entities and nested block content
May delete objects mapped to off/frozen targets when the user chooses Delete
Deletes obsolete source layers after successful mapping
dynamic_parameters: target layer definitions (name, ACI color, linetype)
implementation_notes: This source file is ordinary AutoLISP. ai_mode=dynamic only means CadGPT/AI may derive a temporary validated runtime variant by changing the declared dynamic_parameters without overwriting the permanent library source.
